pdf_styling.disclaimer_text: This inspection report is based on visible and readily accessible conditions at the time of inspection. It is not a warranty or prediction of future performance.

guidance.intro_script: Welcome. We will walk through the entire property section by section. At each stop, say Mark this. then describe what you see before moving on.
guidance.outro_script: Home inspection recording complete. Upload to generate your client-ready PDF.

sections.title: Foundation & Exterior
sections.voice_prompt: Walk around the foundation. Say Mark this. and describe any cracks, settling, grading issues, or water stains.

sections.title: Roof & Exterior Envelope
sections.voice_prompt: From a safe vantage, film the roof and gutters. Say Mark this. and note missing shingles, sagging, or drainage issues.

sections.title: Electrical Service
sections.voice_prompt: Open the main panel if safe. Say Mark this. and describe panel size, labeling, and any visible concerns.

sections.title: Plumbing — Supply & Fixtures
sections.voice_prompt: Show water heater and under-sink areas. Say Mark this. and note leaks, corrosion, or temperature issues.

sections.title: HVAC
sections.voice_prompt: Film the HVAC unit and thermostat. Say Mark this. and describe operation, age if known, and any concerns.

sections.title: Interior — General
sections.voice_prompt: Walk main living areas. Say Mark this. and summarize floors, walls, windows, and moisture signs.

sections.title: Attic / Crawl Space
sections.voice_prompt: If accessible, enter attic or crawl. Say Mark this. or state not accessible. Note insulation, ventilation, pests.
sections.on_screen_text: Attic or crawl — or not accessible

sections.title: Summary & Priorities
sections.voice_prompt: Say Mark this. and give your top three findings and recommended next steps for the client.

sections.title: Foundation and Exterior
sections.default_text: No major issues observed unless noted.
sections.writer_instructions: Detail cracks with location and approximate size when narrated. Recommend structural engineer for significant settlement.

sections.title: Roof and Exterior Envelope
sections.default_text: Roof and drainage documented per narration.
sections.writer_instructions: Note roof covering condition and gutter/downspout performance.

sections.title: Electrical Service
sections.writer_instructions: Include amperage and labeling when stated. Recommend licensed electrician for safety items.

sections.title: Plumbing
sections.writer_instructions: Describe active leaks and water heater condition. Note if supply vs drain unclear.

sections.title: HVAC
sections.writer_instructions: Note operational concerns and maintenance recommendations.

sections.title: Interior
sections.writer_instructions: Cover floors, walls, moisture indicators when mentioned.

sections.title: Attic / Crawl Space
sections.default_text: Attic or crawl space not accessed unless noted.
sections.writer_instructions: If not accessible, state limitation clearly.

sections.title: Summary and Recommendations
sections.writer_instructions: Synthesize top priorities; bullet key client actions in field_values.recommendations.
